news.title: EZVIZ ushers in an era of smart convenience with its scenario-based smart entry portfolio, spanning innovative video doorbells, video doorphones, and gate openers
EZVIZ reveals the next direction towards boundless, ultra-flexible smart home security with its dual- and triple-lens battery cameras and AI innovations at IFA 2026

insights.one_liner: EZVIZ Europe is the Hoofddorp base of a smart home security brand founded in 2013, offering an English-language operations internship.

culture.text: Small Dutch team: about 35 people on LinkedIn, mainly in sales, operations, marketing and HR.
Staff studied business, communication, French and other languages, at schools like the University of Amsterdam and TU Berlin.
Sells smart cameras, video doorbells and other home security products.

open.text: EZVIZ Europe B.V. is an IND recognised visa sponsor.
Its one current job here, an operations internship in Hoofddorp, does not require Dutch.

growth.text: Showed new dual- and triple-lens battery cameras and AI features at IFA 2026.
Launched a range of smart entry products including video doorbells and gate openers.
